CA.name: California
CA.note: Generally 21 days to account for the deposit and return the balance. Receipt, estimate, and photo requirements and exceptions need review.
CA.remedy: Bad-faith retention may support additional damages up to twice the deposit. A court decides; this is not automatic.
CA.check_note: Checked against California Department of Real Estate guidance. Direct statutory page was unavailable; statutory text still needs a direct recheck.

NY.name: New York
NY.note: Covered tenancies: itemization and balance within 14 days. Rent-regulated and other excluded housing need separate review.
NY.remedy: Willful violations may support punitive damages up to twice the deposit, in addition to actual damages.
NY.check_note: Compared the displayed summary with the official statutory text. This is an editorial source check, not attorney review.

TX.name: Texas
TX.note: Generally 30 days after surrender. A written forwarding address is required before the refund duty applies. Unpaid-rent exceptions affect itemization.
TX.remedy: Bad-faith retention may support $100 plus three times the amount wrongfully withheld and reasonable attorney fees.
TX.check_note: Compared the displayed summary with the official statutory text. This is an editorial source check, not attorney review.

FL.name: Florida
FL.note: 15 days for return with no claim; 30 days for compliant claim notice after termination. Object within 15 days of receipt. Early departure and notice exceptions need review.
FL.remedy: No automatic damages multiplier. Late notice can forfeit use of the deposit, without eliminating a separate damages claim. Court costs and attorney fees may apply.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.note: Damage itemization generally within 30 days of vacancy or end of possession, whichever is later. Without required documentation, full return within 45 days. Receipt exceptions and local rules may apply.
IL.remedy: Specified refusal or bad-faith failures may support liability equal to twice the deposit due, plus court costs and reasonable attorney fees.
IL.check_note: Official search excerpts confirmed the 30/45-day rules. The full ILGA page could not be retrieved; receipt exceptions and the remedy require a full-text recheck.
